bibl.title: Retour sur les chasseurs d'Aphrodité: réédition du SB 3.6704
bibl.seg: Carl-Loris Raschel, Retour sur les chasseurs d'Aphrodité: réédition du SB 3.6704.
bibl.note: Reedition with commentaries of a Byzantine papyrus from Aphrodito, P. Gand. Inv. 44 [= S.B. III, 6266 = 6704]. In this contract, the hunters working for a great estate recognize the leaders appointed by their employer and establish rules for their association. An interpretation of the dual activity of these hunters, who seem to make and sell light boats, is outlined. Aphrodite, 23 January 538.
